exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out slightly.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down, keeping your heels on the floor and your knees tracking over your toes.
Lower as far as you can with control, then push through your whole foot to stand.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so your back and hips stay flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safeties and lower the platform with control, without letting your hips lift off the seat.
Press through your whole foot to straighten your legs, without snapping your knees into lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on the rack at about upper-chest height and step under it.
Rest the bar across your upper back, grip it, and lift it off the rack. Take a small step back.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down while your knees track over your toes.
Lower with control, then drive up through your whole foot, keeping your chest up.
Walk the bar back into the rack before you let go.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your elbows pointing down.
Sit straight down between your knees, keeping your chest up and the dumbbell close.
Stand back up by pushing through your whole foot.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad rests on your lower shins.
Hold the handles and keep your hips down on the seat.
Straighten your legs and squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower the weight slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the barbell at hip height with your feet about hip-width apart.
Keep a soft bend in your knees and your back flat.
Push your hips straight back and slide the bar down your thighs until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, keeping the bar close to your legs.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench and the barbell resting across your hips (use a pad for comfort).
Plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart, with your knees bent.
Tuck your chin and drive through your feet to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips with control.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Set a rope attachment on a low pulley. Face away from the machine and reach between your legs to hold the rope.
Walk forward until the cable is under tension, with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a soft bend in your knees and a flat back, letting the rope travel between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, with your feet about hip-width apart.
Keep a soft bend in your knees and your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, keeping the dumbbells close to your legs.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad sits just above your heels.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl your heels down and back toward you, squeezing your hamstrings.
Let the weight return slowly until your legs are almost straight.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows angled back, not flared straight out.
Press the floor away to return to the start.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and your shoulders pulled down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, your feet flat on the floor, and your shoulder blades pulled together.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulder-width and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest.
Press the bar back up to the start. Re-rack it before you let go.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit on the bench with a dumbbell on each thigh, then lie back and bring the dumbbells to chest level.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them with control until you feel a stretch across your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press
instructions: Set both pulleys at about chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand facing away from the machine with one foot forward for balance, and your elbows out to your sides.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, keeping your torso still.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Sit with your back against the pad and your core braced.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them with control back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Unrack the bar at shoulder height and hold it just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, glutes and core braced.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back and then forward once the bar passes your forehead.
Lower the bar with control to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Set both pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet staggered or about hip-width apart, core braced.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet toward your hands so your hips rise into an upside-down V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up to the V position.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit facing the machine with your feet on the footplates and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with your arms straight and sit tall.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight, without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Machine Row
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can reach the handles with your arms straight.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles back, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Set a bench to a slight incline and lie face down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with your chest firmly on the pad.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold the bar just outside your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and a soft bend in your knees.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping it close to your body.
Lower with control, holding the same hinged position the whole time.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and straighten your body, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control until your arms are straight. Bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad so your legs are held firmly in place.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulder-width and sit tall.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Set the assistance so you can control the movement. More assistance makes it easier.
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles.
Pull your chest toward the handles, driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Pulldown
instructions: Set a single handle on a high pulley and sit or kneel facing the machine.
Reach up and hold the handle with one hand, with your chest tall.
Pull your elbow down toward your side, keeping your shoulder away from your ear.
Return slowly until your arm is straight, then repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Set a bar or rope on a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold it with your elbows tucked at your sides and your chest tall.
Straighten your arms down, keeping your elbows where they are.
Let your hands return slowly to chest height.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Set a rope on a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope behind your head with your elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms overhead without letting your elbows flare.
Lower your hands slowly back behind your head.

exercises.name: Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest with straight arms.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten your arms back to the start.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and hold it over your chest.
Lower it to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press back up, then re-rack the bar before you let go.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your upper arms still.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Set a bar on a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold it with an underhand grip and your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your chest.
Let it return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight.
Curl the dumbbells up, keeping your palms facing each other.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms up.
Let the dumbbells roll toward your fingers.
Curl your wrists up, keeping your forearms still.
Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso still.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are about shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a single handle on a low pulley and stand side-on to the machine.
Hold the handle in the hand furthest from the machine, across your body.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is about shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at about head height and hold one end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is under tension, with your arms straight.
Pull the rope toward your face, leading with your elbows and keeping them high.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Reverse Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench and lean forward over your thighs, or lie face down on an incline bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your torso.
Lower them slowly back down.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with straight arms.
Keep your arms straight and your chin level.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower them slowly back down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and your chin level.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower them slowly back down.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform and your shoulders under the pads.
Let your heels drop below the platform until you feel a stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads on your thighs.
Release the safety and let your heels drop until you feel a stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall or rail for balance if you need to.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with your elbows under your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your hips level, neither sagging nor pushed up.
Hold the position, breathing normally. Count the hold as your reps.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar with your arms straight and your legs together.
Brace your core and stop yourself swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your hips up slightly.
Lower your legs slowly back down.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Set a rope on a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope beside your head with your hips still.
Curl your ribs down toward your hips, rounding your upper back.
Return slowly to upright, keeping tension on the cable.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad just below your hip bones and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your back flat.
Bend at the hips to lower your torso until you feel a stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is straight. Do not arch past that.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Start the belt slowly and step on before raising the speed.
Run tall, looking ahead rather than down at your feet.
Keep your steps light and let your arms swing freely.
Slow the belt down to walk before you stop.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of a pedal stroke.
Hold the bars lightly and sit tall.
Pedal at a steady pace, adjusting the resistance to suit your effort.
Ease off gradually at the end rather than stopping suddenly.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Strap your feet in and sit with your shins upright, holding the handle.
Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse it: arms away, lean forward, then bend your knees.
Keep a steady rhythm rather than rushing the recovery.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the handles at hip height with your elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your whole arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing softly on your toes.
Keep your jumps small and the rhythm steady.
